newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Nov trade surplus rises to 781.7 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Nov trade surplus rises to 781.7 mln Sfr.

text.p: Switzerland's trade surplus rose to 781.7 million Swiss francs in November from a revised 226.8 million surplus in October, the Federal Customs Office said.
Note - Original October surplus 248.2 million francs, imports 8,450.7 million and exports 8,698.9 million.
The figures above were for the index Total 1, or all goods except precious metals, precious stones, art objects aand antiques.
The following figures comprise Total 2, or trade in all goods, including precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques
Note - The October figures are revised from an original surplus of 271.8 million francs, imports at 8,900.8 million and exports at 9.172.6 million.
